title: Mentorship, Passion, and Entrepreneurship with Heather Miller
description:
Have you ever been told that if you stick to just one thing, you'll be more successful? For today's guest, Heather Miller, that couldn't be further from the truth. If you're multi-talented and know that your passions are an asset to your success, you're going to love this episode. Tune in to this interview as we dive deep into:
1. What it looks like to pursue your passions as a multi-talented entrepreneur, 2. Democratizing mentorship: the importance of community, mentors, and role models in supporting your success path and 3. The art of the pivot: from successful corporate career to entrepreneur and adapting to a new work/life balance as a working mom.
